old_problem: The source did not define which graphics processes were allowed, while an invasive diagnostic can conflict with live contexts; a generic PASS could mask workload termination or tenant impact.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA defines the Graphics Processes software check as detecting a process using a target GPU that can interfere with invasive diagnostics. Workload-owner drain and independent before/after inventory provide a safe, non-destructive oracle.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row359 all 18 XLSX columns and history2954.
No process was inspected beyond source records, terminated, or disrupted.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 graphics-process interference and workload-isolation check
test_case.purpose: Prove every target GPU is free of interfering graphics contexts before the invasive level-4 run and that no unapproved workload is exposed, terminated or lost.
required_package: GPU UUID/entity and authorized PID/owner/container inventory
Compatible driver/DCGM and supported service state
OOB, monitoring, abort and runtime-state recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Capture authorized per-GPU process inventory; require owners to drain target GPUs without automated termination; establish approved DCGM state, run one full level-4 diagnostic, record the Graphics Processes check and all tests/skips, then recapture process/runtime health and restore states.
test_case.expected_result: No interfering graphics process exists on any target at launch, the named check passes without `DCGM_FR_GRAPHICS_PROCESSES`, all expected diagnostics pass, and no unauthorized process or tenant data is exposed or affected.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an independently empty target-process set at the run boundary plus the named DCGM result and full suite accounting; killing a process to obtain PASS is prohibited.
safety_gate: Never terminate an unknown or unapproved PID
Monitor workload/GPU/host health; stop on unexpected context or impact; no retry
expected_evidence: Authorized redacted pre/post GPU process inventories
Graphics Processes result code and skips
test_case.recovery: If an unexpected process appears, do not kill it; abort the diagnostic, notify its owner, restore recorded runtime state, verify workload/GPU health and reschedule only through new authorization.

source_conflict.reason: The documented interference condition supplies the title oracle; owner drain, cumulative level 4 and service readiness resolve the generic source gaps.

blocked.reason: The process condition is authoritative; ownership and isolation are runtime prerequisites.
